test_cases.title: Generate Inventory Levels Report (Equivalence Partition - Inventory Levels)
test_cases.preconditions: System contains active inventory data across warehouse locations and product categories.
steps: Navigate to the Reports module in the system.
Select 'Inventory Levels' from the report type menu.
Set parameter filters for location and product category.
test_cases.expected_result: The system generates an accurate Inventory Levels report displaying stock quantities, reorder thresholds, and location breakdowns for all matching products.

test_cases.title: Generate Product Movement Report (Equivalence Partition - Product Movement)
test_cases.preconditions: System contains historical transaction logs of stock transfers, receipts, and dispatches.
steps: Navigate to the Reports module in the system.
Select 'Product Movement' from the report type menu.
Specify a valid start and end date range for product movements.
test_cases.expected_result: The system generates a Product Movement report detailing inbound, outbound, and internal transfers for the specified date range.

test_cases.title: Generate Sales History Report (Equivalence Partition - Sales History)
test_cases.preconditions: System contains completed sales transaction records.
steps: Navigate to the Reports module in the system.
Select 'Sales History' from the report type menu.
Set the time period filter to 'Previous Quarter'.
test_cases.expected_result: The system generates a Sales History report displaying sales volume, total revenue, unit counts, and transaction details for the selected quarter.

test_cases.title: End-to-End Workflow: Filter, Generate, Preview, and Export Report
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in with reporting authorization and system has populated inventory and sales data.
steps: Apply custom filters: Date Range = 'Last 30 Days', Category = 'All Categories', Group By = 'Weekly'.
Click 'Run Report' and wait for the preview page to render.
Verify the displayed report summary and detail tables match the filter criteria.
Click the 'Export' button and choose 'PDF format'.
Open the exported document to confirm readability and accurate data export.
test_cases.expected_result: The system executes the full report generation workflow smoothly, accurately displays filtered data in the preview interface, and successfully exports the report as a matching PDF file.
